# src/components/wizard/steps/ai

Compiled from `contracts/rules`. Change a rule there (`npm run learn -- ...`), never here.

- **invariant** `wizard/ask-pro-tier-thing-which-graphic`: Ask the Pro tier ONE thing: which graphic types the design language is rendered as, every box ticked by default and the LAST tick not removable. The first member in package order is the PRIMARY - previewed, refined, and the one the single-graphic ending handles. Compose members the moment the result lands, each through the same gate the primary took, and DROP and NAME one the gate refuses rather than shipping it.
- **invariant** `wizard/hold-user-key-only-unsaved-password`: Hold a user AI key only in the unsaved password-field state and submit it to the credentials endpoint. Never pass a key through the settings object, browser storage, query parameters, telemetry, logs or rendered error detail. Model lists are provider-scoped suggestions, not an application-wide allowlist.
- **invariant** `wizard/keep-thread-composer-single-transcript-talk`: Keep ONE thread and ONE composer: a single transcript of talk turns plus earlier generations kept whole, each restorable, with restoring archiving whatever it displaces. The one textarea generates, talks or refines, the primary button follows the state, and the refine placeholder is retained so the composer answers to the same locator either way.
- **invariant** `wizard/let-directions-survive-refinement-keep-current`: Let the directions SURVIVE a refinement: keep `alternatives` and `originals` as parallel arrays, replace only the selected one on refine, and offer an undo that restores the proposed design without spending a generation. Stage the pick with `stagePick` on selection AND after every refinement - chosen facets from the direction as it stands, shown from the ORIGINALS - and stage nothing for a lone result.
- **invariant** `wizard/make-create-merged-describe-import-step`: Make Create with AI the MERGED describe and import step: one drop zone accepting images AND an existing template. A dropped template parses deterministically into a card offering the byte-faithful "open as code" import, which renders OUTSIDE the sign-in gate and must stay there, or a guided Convert. Only the AI actions are an account feature.
- **invariant** `wizard/name-proven-design-result-adapted-show`: Name the PROVEN DESIGN a result was adapted from and show what it was chosen between: the design name on the card and the retrieved shortlist under it as MiniPreview cards, on the same chassis as the three directions and a Browse tile. Picking another REBUILDS on it deterministically with the same spec, no model call and no cost, and needs no structural check because every design on the shortlist satisfies the brief anchor by construction.
- **invariant** `wizard/offer-pro-tier-only-where-can`: Offer the Pro tier only where it can actually run - the status answer AND the metering backend - and where that is false make it ABSENT, never a greyed row and never a key request. Its settings are one read-back with the remaining allowance and no chooser of any kind: no provider, no model, no key. A hosted deployment is never reachable from the browser through a flag, a query parameter or a stored key.
- **invariant** `wizard/offer-three-execution-tiers-under-settings`: Offer three execution tiers under one settings panel every tier can reach, defaulting to the managed tier when the server offers it and otherwise to bring-your-own-key. The stored id `custom` never changes however the label reads. The managed tiers name NO mechanism and pick no model; bring-your-own-key is the deliberate advanced surface. A tier this build cannot run is ABSENT, never greyed.
- **invariant** `wizard/show-money-result-card-prices-codebase`: Show NO money on the result card - prices are not in this codebase and a stale one would be believed - and print zero tokens as silence, because "0 tokens" is a measurement claim rather than the absence of one. Take cost from the telemetry ring as a median expectation before Generate, null below two matching runs, and actuals after, recorded on a RUN and never on a re-pick.
- **trap** `wizard/archive-current-result-before-recording-new`: Archive the current result BEFORE recording the new request, and record the request even when the box was empty and the brief came from the talk.
- **rule** `wizard/branch-pro-ending-size-set-never`: Branch the Pro ending on the SIZE of the set, never the tier: a set of more than one finishes through the kit ending into a production, and each member is renamed for its type because that name is the export slug and the playout folder an operator reads.
- **rule** `wizard/carry-line-read-back-what-will`: Carry a one-line read-back of what will actually run on the settings button, so the common case needs no click. The panel is NOT a popover: it opens ITSELF whenever nothing is configured, and a floating sheet would cover the controls it exists to make work.
- **rule** `wizard/carry-what-picture-own-upload-card`: Carry WHAT A PICTURE IS FOR on its own upload card - use it as it is, make one like this, take the look and feel, make it work over this - because the purpose is a property of the PICTURE and not of the gesture. Never split it into separate drop zones. The guess preselects visibly, one click to correct, and only ever guesses mark-or-not.
- **rule** `wizard/handle-pro-finding-step-cannot-repair`: Handle a Pro finding the step cannot repair by clamping categories to the supported set, demoting spec-field findings to warnings against a fixed contract with no repair loop, and standing refine and fix down, because regenerating is the honest move.
- **rule** `wizard/inject-harness-validator-every-provider-call`: Inject the harness validator into every provider call, stream the progress stages into the busy line, show the route badge on the result card, and pass a grounded result spec back on refine so spec-level refinement re-assembles deterministically.
- **rule** `wizard/keep-harness-default-renders-three-directions`: Keep the harness ON by default. On, it renders three directions as picker cards - a live MiniPreview of each built template plus its design words and a pass or fail mark. Off, it is one shot with static validation and no bench. Conversion of an imported template always runs the validated flow regardless of the checkbox.
- **rule** `wizard/keep-more-control-optional-structured-setup`: Keep "More control" OPTIONAL structured setup beside the prompt, editing ONE generation spec across category, data fields, look, fonts and animation. Collapsed sections show summary chips and keep their values, the spec persists as a cross-session draft and lands on the store at Create, and an EMPTY spec injects nothing so a prompt-only user never touches it.
- **rule** `wizard/keep-smallest-managed-tier-smallest-result`: Keep the smallest managed tier smallest: one result, remaining allowance, at most two fields, no image or logo input and no style reference, with provider and model settings, brainstorm, raw mode, alternatives, conversion and code repair all hidden. An unsupported response shows the server explanation and one simplification, and acceptance is recorded by generation id, which is transient and never enters the template or the saved graphic.
- **rule** `wizard/offer-fix-these-failing-non-managed`: Offer "fix these" on a failing non-managed result as a BUTTON and never an automatic loop, sending the exact validator findings back as the instruction at CODE level. Use the per-card verdict class, not the one that names the verdict on the current result. The smallest managed tier instead labels the same failure a platform defect and spends no repair call.
- **rule** `wizard/report-pro-result-card-language-rationale`: Report on the Pro result card the language, its rationale, its palette and every divergence the platform recorded, keyed to the template by WeakMap so a restored past result shows its own. There is NO concept image: the graphic rendered above the card IS the answer.
- **rule** `wizard/take-only-assets-design-around-these`: Take only the as-is assets into the "design around these with a catalog template" escape, and continue into the images, category and template flow. Hand the as-is paths to the production validator so that screen rides the injected validator. A video composition passes no binding choice, since it reaches a picture through a declared image input.
- **rule** `wizard/travel-conversation-created-project-report-talk`: Travel the conversation with the created project: report talk turns up on every change so talk added after the last result is caught, commit them at create, and persist them exactly as the spec is. Only the TALK turns travel - the generation snapshots are heavy and the editor has no surface for them - and the editor shows the carried conversation read-only.
